verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a usage-based charging model: it bills for compute rather than wall time, and agents cost nothing when inactive. That implies cost tracks workload rather than headcount, but nothing in the pack states that pricing is or is not per-seat, or mentions minimum seat counts. Missing for 10: an explicit statement on per-seat vs. usage pricing, documentation of any seat minimums or team-size cost scaling, a published pricing/plan breakdown, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know whether pricing is per-seat with minimum seat counts that increase cost as my team grows

citations.quote: Cloudflare charges only for compute, not wall time, even during long agent workflows or hibernating WebSockets.
